correctness.rationale: All negative irreducible curves are classified: for any other horizontal \(C=aS_0+bF\), the bounds \(m_i\le a\) and \(\sum_i m_i\le b\) imply \(\widetilde C^2\ge a(b-ea)\ge0\). Pair intersections are computed explicitly. No support contains both \(E_i\) and \(G_i\); eliminating disjoint negative leaves gives exact conditions \(f<e\) and \(a<n-e\) for selected sections. The four cases partition supports, and their binomial sums prove the formula. Exact principal-minor enumeration in the stated small ranges corroborates but is not the general proof.

value.rationale: This natural two-parameter family of smooth rational surfaces has unbounded Picard number. The theorem classifies all negative curves and computes the complete Zariski-chamber support profile, including maximal supports counted by \(2^n-\binom ne\). The two section weights induce simultaneous numerical restrictions beyond the plane boundary \(e=1\); elementary transformations account for the exchange symmetry. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or table.
